content.short: Awaken Tax is tax software built for Web3 that analyzes on-chain transactions, including NFTs, lending, staking, and trading.
content.description: Awaken Tax is the first product that understands your on-chain transactions—a Web3 tax solution that analyzes activity across NFTs, lending, staking, and trading on Ethereum, Arbitrum, Avalanche, OP Mainnet, BNB Chain, Solana, Polygon, Base, Multichain, and more to simplify crypto filings. It captures the full scope of your on-chain activity to help you save time and money when preparing taxes. Give it a try for free, and you only pay when you want to generate a complete, detailed crypto tax report.
